analysis.title: Nordic Alert: Fed on hold, raises rates later this year
key_insights: SEB expects the Fed to leave rates unchanged at today's decision, with markets pricing more than a 90% probability of no change. SEB maintains its call for one more rate hike in December.
SEB forecasts rate cuts toward the end of 2027 and during the first half of 2028, after the December hike.
The Fed outlook is uncertain, with the Middle East conflict, US economic strength and financial conditions named as the key factors.
The Bank of Canada is expected to raise rates from 2.25% to 2.50% as inflation rises and GDP grows at a healthy pace.
New Zealand's central bank unexpectedly left rates unchanged in a split decision, citing global uncertainty. The currency fell after the announcement.
The UK budget is expected to be cautious and focused on households and small businesses. Policy is constrained by high taxes, large deficits and high interest rates.
US equities closed higher: the S&P 500 rose 0.6% and the Nasdaq rose 1.2%. Asian markets were mostly higher on renewed technology optimism.
South Korea's market rose more than 6% overnight, led by technology stocks after SK Hynix reported strong results and promised substantial dividends. Japan's Nikkei gained just over 1%.
Microsoft and Alphabet report earnings today, alongside the Fed decision. Futures point to a slightly lower open in Europe and slightly higher in the US.
Oil prices rose slightly overnight after reports that the US told Persian Gulf countries to prepare for a short but intense attack after the US midterm elections.
Israel's election produced a split result between Netanyahu's coalition and the opposition bloc. Arab parties outside both blocs are gaining seats, so forming a government will be difficult.
Norwegian retail sales ex. autos rose 0.6% m/m in August after a slump in the previous month. SEB expects higher purchasing power to support consumption, with momentum improving into 2027.
The Swedish krona strengthened slightly against the euro yesterday and has been stable against the euro and the dollar overnight.
earnings_insights: Microsoft and Alphabet report earnings today (2026-10-28), with no estimates given in the report.
SK Hynix reported strong results and promised substantial dividends, per the report. No figures are given.

macro_indicators.interpretation: A hold is the expected outcome. Anything else would be a major surprise.
SEB sees a hike in December, followed by cuts at the end of 2027 and in the first half of 2028.
A 25bp hike is expected on rising inflation and healthy GDP growth.
The hold was unexpected and the NZ currency fell.
A rebound after the previous month's slump. Household consumption was weak in H1.

risk_factors: The Middle East conflict and possible US action in the Persian Gulf after the midterms.
US economic strength and developments in financial conditions could shift the Fed path.
UK fiscal constraints from high taxes, large deficits and high interest rates could cause market jitters around the budget.
Political uncertainty in Israel after a split election.
vol_and_positioning: Equity markets were described as somewhat more nervous recently ahead of the Fed decision.
geopolitical: The US has reportedly told countries around the Persian Gulf to prepare for a short but intense attack after the US midterm elections.
The Middle East conflict is cited as a key uncertainty for the Fed outlook.
Israel's election produced a roughly even split between Netanyahu's coalition and the opposition bloc, with Arab party seats rising.
Brazil's Bolsonaro arrived in the US after losing the election in Brazil.
